description: QodeX — a local-first LLM agent & AI coding CLI agent for your terminal. Runs local models (Qwen3-Coder via Ollama/LM Studio) with deterministic guardrails, 100+ tools, a real browser, smart vision & shareable live artifacts. Open source, Apache-2.0.
